source.pr_title: Fix `naturalsize()` rounding rollover at unit boundaries

description: A real, small merged bug fix: naturalsize() chose its suffix (kB/MB/...) before rounding, so rounding could push the mantissa up to the base while the suffix stayed stale (999999 -> '1000.0 kB' instead of '1.0 MB'). seed/mod.py is the verbatim pre-fix naturalsize()+suffixes table (i18n _gettext stubbed as identity, behavior-preserving for the English-locale tests here). seed/test_mod.py is the real parametrized test_naturalsize suite from that commit (trimmed for size, all 6 real new rollover regression assertions kept) — the oracle this case is judged against.
note: generate/qa phases are skipped for this case — seed/ is copied in as-is and only `atomic-forge repair` runs. This case is a numeric/formatting bug (not a missing guard/index bug like the other two more-itertools cases), for some diversity in what kind of bug the repair loop has to localize and fix.
